verdicts.reason: A has a sensible three-column banner with the logo kept prominent, but the headline is broken into four lines with one word each ("the" stands alone), so it overwhelms the frame. The CTA is oversized, and the legal block is crammed against the CTA and the bottom edge. B is worse. The logo shrinks to an illegible stamp beside the legal text, the price is nearly as large as the headline and competes with it, and "warranty" and "m." are left as orphans. The centre stack is vertically cramped while the CTA floats far to the right, cut off from its copy.
